mapper.insert: insert into impoundment (company, name, address, longitude, latitude, date, manage_unit, volume, control_water_level, responsible_person, phone, rtu_code, note, create_time, update_time, point) values (#{company}, #{name}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{date}, #{manageUnit}, #{volume}, #{controlWaterLevel}, #{responsiblePerson}, #{phone}, #{rtuCode}, #{note}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, st_pointfromtext(#{geom}))
